scopeLimits: Only the exact six-case synthetic Toy64 pair (canonical JSON UTF-8 bytes / 64 rounded up, max output512) is qualified here; no tokenizer or provider equivalence.
Same process, unbound request{} parent foreign-key fixture. No OS restart, published/bound host, lease/fence, concurrency, full TR05/TR08, real data, production or global release conclusion.
NUL occurs only in checkpoint fixturePadding. Native PostgreSQL journal NUL behavior is outside this proof; no functionality or resolution of its separately required failures is inferred.

Read guards/transform hooks are user-space instrumentation, not a kernel sandbox or during-execution attestation. Captured Node fs APIs and transformed source hashes are checked. Native/OS/internal-loader reads are not proven exhaustively intercepted; a 63-package/4176-file post-run static dependency inventory supplements observed reads and is not an execution list.

Primary execution and subsequent runner commands retain argv, cwd, environment names, raw stdout/stderr and exits. Initial manifest/source bootstrap read-only tool calls and script-creation heredocs exist in the conversation transcript; they were not all launched through the later disk recorder.
